correctness.rationale: The one-impulse recurrence solves exactly: m_t=(1-beta_1)beta_1^{t-1}G and v_t=beta_2(1+beta_2)^{t-1}G^2. Substitution into the displayed bias correction gives the stated decreasing v-hat and the increasing kernel F_t from 1 to sqrt((1+beta_2)/beta_2). The gain is an expectation of F_N under a geometric N; stochastic ordering of geometric laws proves strict increase in beta_1 and bounded convergence gives the sharp beta_1-to-1 ceiling. At beta_1=0 the gain is 1. The source-default numerical value and ceiling were independently checked. Under the stated Adam convention, the impulse tail is asymptotic to a positive constant times (beta_1/sqrt(beta_2))^{t-1}, so summability is exactly beta_1<sqrt(beta_2).
